summary: Iteration 52 — Stripe Webhook Handlers Testing (Backend Only). 28/28 tests PASS (100%) after one test-infrastructure fix. All webhook events verified: payment transitions (authorized/captured/failed/cancelled), charge refunds (full/partial), refund.updated, subscription lifecycle (created/updated/deleted), invoice.paid/payment_failed, idempotence, anti-regression guards, DB event tracking, and 2 full e2e cycles.

Fixed by auto-creating a temporary test plan 'plan_test_iter52_webhook' in fixture setup + cleanup on teardown.
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty ('') → no HMAC signature verification. Expected in test env, must be set in production.

critical_code_review_comments: webhook_handlers.py: Architecture clean and complete. dispatch() properly implements idempotence (INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), routes all 13+ event types, logs errors without re-raising (Stripe gets 200 always). Anti-regression guards (WHERE status NOT IN (...)) work correctly for all state transitions.

webhook_handlers.py: _resolve_payment_id() fallback chain works correctly: metadata.payment_id → stripe_payment_intent_id → stripe_checkout_session_id → stripe_charge_id. All 4 lookup strategies tested and passing.
payment_routes.py: Webhook endpoint correctly refactored to ~15 lines, fully delegates to webhook_handlers.dispatch(). Clean separation of concerns.
subscription_plans table: Table is empty in current DB. Tests now auto-create a temporary plan. Main agent should populate this table with real plans for the app to function.

rca_of_issue.bug: Test fixture user_ids returned hardcoded 'plan_basic' when subscription_plans table is empty
rca_of_issue.root_cause: subscription_plans table has no rows. The fixture query 'SELECT plan_id FROM subscription_plans WHERE active=TRUE LIMIT 1' returned None, triggering the 'plan_basic' fallback. Since 'plan_basic' doesn't exist as a FK, all insert_test_subscription() calls raised ForeignKeyViolationError.
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Modified user_ids fixture to INSERT a temporary test plan ('plan_test_iter52_webhook') when no active plan is found, use it for tests, and DELETE it during module teardown.
